warnings: y-axis total row prints 14.15 but the 5 printed segments as I first read them (4.00+2.00+3.60+1.80+3.15) sum to 14.55, a 0.40m mismatch. Re-checking against the total row (the exact check §4 exists for): 4.00+2.00+3.20+1.80+3.15=14.15 resolves exactly if the ง-ค segment is 3.20 (not 3.60) — used 3.20 for ค's pos_m. This is a resolved reading, not a guess: the total-row cross-check is decisive, but the ง-ค segment's own digit was genuinely hard to distinguish (3.60 vs 3.20) at this scan's resolution/rotation, so confidence on that one line is lower than the rest.

Rows ข(11.00m) and ก(14.15m) only carry structure for a small south-projecting carport at grid columns 2-3 (footings C1,F2/CX,F2 at ข, C1,F2/C1,F2 at ก) — the main house footprint only spans ฉ(0.00) to ค(9.20m). Both rows are still real printed main grid lines (circled on the left margin like ฉ/จ/ง/ค), not dummies.

House title block: 'บ้านครอบครัวไทยเป็นสุข 2' (กรมโยธาธิการและผังเมือง, โครงการแบบอาคารเพื่อประชาชน, เลขที่แบบ ม.บ.462120, 21 พ.ย. 2546) — all-steel roof structure (hip roof, RB1/RB2 rafters + CN/CX king posts) over an RC footing/column/beam/slab substructure; a different series from both บ้าน_เล็ก_1ชั้น_07 (house 26) and the บ้านครอบครัวไทยร่วมสมัย series (houses 01-05).

z_levels[] and the z dimension_chain read 2026-08-28 off A-06 (หน้า07, 'รูปตัด ก,ข ขยายหลังคา') -- an architectural section sheet that sits OUTSIDE this house's recorded op04 pass-2 scope (side_profile/section architectural pages were deliberately skipped), opened specifically because the master carried an empty z_levels[]. The chain closes on itself: 0.60 + 3.25 = 3.85 and 3.85 + 3.32 = 7.17, both matching the printed levels exactly. ระดับฝ้าเพดาน is genuinely printed twice at two heights (2.60 over the bathrooms, 2.80 over the main rooms) and both are kept.

UNVERIFIED OBSERVATION, not acted on: A-06 (หน้า07) prints the y-axis chain as 3.15 / 1.80 / 3.60 / 2.00 / 3.00 / 1.00 with a printed total of 14.55, while this master's y_lines (read from the structural plan หน้า12) give ก->ข 3.15, ข->ค 1.80, ค->ง 3.20, ง->จ 2.00, จ->ฉ' 3.00, ฉ'->ฉ 1.00, total 14.15. The whole 0.40 gap sits in the single ค->ง bay (3.60 vs 3.20). Read off a reduced-resolution scan and NOT confirmed, so nothing was changed and no chain was written from that sheet -- the resolved y_lines still come from the structural plan. Worth one higher-resolution look at หน้า07 vs หน้า12 before anyone trusts either number.

confidence_flags: ง-ค segment read as 3.20, resolving a 0.40m mismatch against the printed 14.15 total — see file warnings
